confidence_notes: Restaurant and bar anchors rest on aggregated, mostly crowd-sourced guide figures, several undated or from different years, with EGP conversions of about 50-53 per USD. Wine has no direct price found, so it is set at roughly 1.7 times the beer anchor, the local price relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no price search or live listing check, so they are low confidence and the widest uncertainty. FX could not be confirmed on the RBA table: the 2026-11-03 value of 0.6976 comes from a secondary report, and the source_url was not read directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Sinai Red Sea resort pricing, anchored to Cairo and Egypt-wide restaurant averages and adjusted up for the reported Sharm El Sheikh premium over Cairo (about 41%). Bar prices are from Naama Bay guide ranges. Hotel and hostel anchors are general knowledge of Naama Bay and budget resort-town levels for a July low-season window.
